units.source_text: 我所写的《奉教人之死》一篇，为了发表对文字作了必要的润色，

en.t: For publication, I made the necessary stylistic polish to the text of the piece I wrote, The Death of a Christian,

units.source_text: 如果原作文雅不俗，对原作没有损毁，就十分荣幸了。

en.t: I would be deeply honored if the original remains elegant and unvulgar, and if I have not damaged it.
